exposure: Fetal electrocardiography (FECG) parameters (STV, LTV, AC/DC, SI)
cohort: The study included 39 women between 24 and 38 weeks of pregnancy.
finding: The study found no significant differences in maternal/fetal HRV, term of delivery, neonatal anthropometric data, or Apgar score based on the mode of delivery, but did establish correlations between fetal AC/DC indicators and Apgar score, and other relationships via logistic regression.
mod_finding: Electronic monitoring based on non-invasive FECG had no influence on the choice of the mode of delivery, and maternal/fetal HRV, term, neonatal anthropometric data, and Apgar score were not significantly different according to the mode of delivery.
followup_time: Until delivery and immediate postpartum for neonatal data collection.
